sourceContext: Human clarified strict isolation: Dashboard Analytics must be a brand-new ORCHESTOR task, branch, worktree, run and Codex thread, fully separate from Implementar v3. Only after local completion and explicit human approval may it be published/merged and then allowed to flow to production through the normal release path.
objective: Implement Dashboard Analytics V1 in a completely isolated task lane from Implementar v3, using a new branch/worktree/thread/run from current main, then stop at human approval before any publication, merge or production release.
scope: This is a NEW task, not a continuation of Implementar v3.
Create exactly one new persistent Codex thread for this task with visible name Dashboard Analytics.
Create exactly one new ORCHESTOR run for this task.
Create a dedicated isolated Git worktree for Dashboard Analytics.
Create/use branch orchestor/dashboard-analytics-v1 from exact baseline main@40dcf41be59e8e384ee05c544d4af56747c488e0.
Do not checkout, rebase, merge, cherry-pick, reset, amend or otherwise mutate the Implementar v3 branch/worktree/thread/run.
Do not reuse files from any dirty or in-progress Implementar v3 worktree. Read only canonical main plus planning/dashboard-analytics-v1 docs as reference.
Planning branch is reference-only; do not merge it because it contains unrelated historical changes.
Implement Dashboard Analytics V1 only in the new isolated worktree/branch.
Primary KPIs: Facturado, Cobrado, Pendiente de cobro, Gastos.
Primary temporal chart: Facturado/Cobrado/Gastos over selected period.
Secondary analytics: invoice financial state and expense-category distribution; top clients/client evolution only when semantics are provably safe.
Use real authenticated app data, current Costa Clean design-system primitives/tokens, mobile-first responsive layout, dark/light, reduced motion, loading/empty/error/partial states.
Recharts is the only pre-authorized new chart runtime after local compatibility/bundle validation.
No shadcn, Tremor, Motion for React or TanStack Table runtime dependency in this task without a new explicit approval.
No schema/RLS/RPC/remote DB changes for V1.
Autonomous loop: audit -> plan -> implement -> test -> review -> repair -> rereview -> certify.
At local completion, stop at LOCAL_COMPLETE / HUMAN_PUBLICATION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
Do not push application source, create/update PR, merge or deploy until explicit human approval.
After later human approval, publish this isolated branch for review/PR. Production may only happen after that separate approval and successful merge/release checks.
outOfScope: Any merge from Implementar v3 into Dashboard Analytics before explicit integration approval.
Any merge from Dashboard Analytics into Implementar v3.
Any application source push/PR/merge/deploy before explicit human approval.
Supabase remote mutation, Vercel production mutation, secrets, DNS, billing, payments, external communications.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard Analytics has its own task metadata, thread, run, worktree and branch.
Implementation branch is orchestor/dashboard-analytics-v1 and starts from baseline 40dcf41be59e8e384ee05c544d4af56747c488e0.
Implementar v3 branch/worktree/thread/run are byte/state untouched by this task.
No uncommitted or branch-only Implementar v3 changes appear in Dashboard Analytics worktree.
Planning branch is used only as documentation reference.
Dashboard Analytics implementation and QA complete locally with scoped review/repair loop.
Full tests, lint, typecheck, build and required responsive/accessibility checks pass.
Remote application mutations=0 before publication approval.
requiredApprovals: Any application git push or GitHub publication.
Any integration with in-progress Implementar v3 work before both branches are independently complete.
stopConditions: Exact main baseline cannot be established.
Isolation from Implementar v3 cannot be proven.
Dashboard worktree contains Implementar v3-only changes.
A merge/rebase with Implementar v3 becomes necessary.
Local quality gates cannot pass without broad unrelated changes.
verificationRequirements: Report DASHBOARD_THREAD_ID, DASHBOARD_RUN_ID, DASHBOARD_WORKTREE, DASHBOARD_BRANCH and BASELINE_SHA.
Report IMPLEMENTAR_V3_UNTOUCHED=YES with branch/worktree/thread/run isolation evidence.
Run and report focused tests, full tests, lint, typecheck, build, responsive/accessibility/dark-light/reduced-motion checks.
Run at least one review/repair/rereview cycle if findings exist.
Report REMOTE_MUTATIONS=0, PRODUCTION_MUTATIONS=0 and final LOCAL_COMPLETE state.
Stop and request human publication approval before push/PR/merge/deploy.
